## Description

The input contained AP242 saved-view entities (`CAMERA_MODEL_D3`, `PRESENTATION_VIEW`, `DRAUGHTING_PRE_DEFINED_CURVE_FONT`); the re-emitted file omits them. The geometry is preserved but the curated set of "look from front", "look from above" views the original author defined is gone. Bug-reporter language: "saved views gone after re-export", "lost camera positions".

## Reproducer recipe

a clean MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP fixture with no `CAMERA_MODEL_D3` and a comment indicating the input had three saved views.

## Expected kernel behavior

preserve saved-view entities on round-trip when the output schema supports them.

## Notes

AP242-specific; AP203 has no saved-view representation. Bytes alone are insufficient to demonstrate this defect — needs sibling input fixture. Tagged provenance_tier: requires-sibling-pair.
